# Third-Party Assets

## The Zombie - Free Sprites

- Asset: The Zombie - Free Sprites (male character frames only)
- Author: pzUH / GameArt2D
- Source page: https://opengameart.org/content/the-zombie-free-sprites
- Direct archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/ZombieFiles.zip
- License: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (CC0-1.0)
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Download date: 2026-09-23
- Used for: NormalZombie.prefab and the shared body visual of ConeheadZombie.prefab
- Imported files: 45 transparent PNG frames (Idle 15, Walk 10, Attack 8, Dead 12)
- Attribution: Not required. Credited here for provenance.

The archive was downloaded from the source page above, verified as a valid ZIP,
and contained PNG artwork only. The archive itself is intentionally not committed.
No executable files, scripts, Unity packages, ripped Plants vs. Zombies content, or
copyrighted PvZ/PvZ2 artwork are included.

## Assets reviewed but not integrated

Plant, projectile, sun, environment, and UI candidates were not materially better
than the existing generated presentation while meeting the required style and
license confidence. The existing generated placeholders remain in use.
